name: EPIC 211428126
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 18, 5.0 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211428126 (K2 campaign 18): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.031668 (16th-84th percentiles 4.853945-5.215979), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,621 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 18, give 1.05 solar masses and 5.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,998 K at its surface.
